acceptanceCriteria: attempt show and ticket show include a bounded tail (or a reference to it) of the most recent failed gate's retained output.
A test covers a GATE_FAILED attempt.
body: Residual of lane PR beamfall/corvint#1517 (policy-closeout-1021u, V1-2196). V1-2196 made focused-docs and full-gate retain output evidence for GATE_FAILED. Expected: attempt show and ticket show display the retained tail of the failed gate so an agent can diagnose without re-running. Actual: the tail is retained but only reachable through the gate record.
title: attempt show and ticket show do not re-show the retained failed-gate output tail
